card.name: Words just before a large figure
card.fires_on: Words and punctuation right before a big number or amount, such as 'capable', 'can yield', 'can generate', 'reaching weights' or a colon before a count. Mostly general web prose about output, cost or size.

modes.label: Capacity verbs
modes.description: Verbs or adjectives saying what something can produce or reach, just before a quantity.
modes.example: cool-white LED that can<< generate>> up to 900 lm of

modes.label: Colon before a figure
modes.description: A colon or hedge that introduces a number comparing two sizes.
modes.example: But the effort cost the Germans far more<<:>> 200,000

modes.label: Range hedges
modes.description: Hedging words before an upper bound of a measured amount.
modes.example: by at least 160 percent and<< perhaps>> by as much as 1,1

card.writes: Weakly favors Chinese words for 'insufficient' or 'necessary' and other scattered tokens, so no clear output effect beyond a loose sense of degree.
card.plain: It lights up on words that lead into a big number, such as what something can produce or reach.
